{{Quote|This is High Flight Three. I'm hit by debris. Experiencing engine shutdown.|The pilot during the Selaggis engagement|<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>}}
'''High Flight Three''' was a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[High Flight Squadron]]. The pilot flew during the [[Battle of Selaggis]], and was hit by debris in an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field surrounding [[Selaggis VI]] when the strike force broke off its attack against [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']].
